presets.title: Analyze Photograph | Urban Architecture
presets.prompt:
Analyze this urban or architectural photograph.

Include:
- Type of structure
- Architectural style and materials
- City context and density cues
- Presence of people or vehicles
- Lighting and weather conditions
- Symmetry, lines, and perspective

End with:
A) clean architectural prompt
B) cinematic urban environment prompt
presets.summary: Use this prompt to analyze an urban or architectural photograph and generate a detailed textual breakdown. Provide the type of structure, architectural style and materials, city context and density cues, proportion and symmetry, lighting on surfaces, street‑level activity, and overall atmosphere. Paste the image description or reference and receive a comprehensive analysis suitable for scene‑prompt creation. Format: Prompt Pack. Source pack: 🤖 Photo Analysis (Image Gen).

presets.title: Analyze Image
presets.prompt:
Analyze the image in depth across these categories:

1. Main Subject
2. Physical Appearance
3. Pose or Behavior
4. Background Setting
5. Lighting and Mood
6. Color Palette

Write a rich, vivid prompt that stays descriptive but avoids unnecessary adjectives. Maintain accuracy. This prompt will be used for AI image generation, so clarity matters. Produce 2 versions at the end: a simple prompt and an advanced cinematic prompt.
